underlying_model: ECMWF ERA5 Reanalysis (0.25 deg grid resolution)
citation: Open-Meteo.com Historical Weather Archive API (ERA5 Reanalysis by ECMWF). Data retrieved for New Delhi, India (28.6139° N, 77.209° E) spanning 1950-01-01 to 2026-10-10.
limitations: ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis data represents a 0.25° (~31 km) grid cell; micro-scale urban street canyon variations are smoothed.
Archive updates lag real-time by approximately 2–5 days due to ERA5 assimilation cycles.
Daily maximum reflects 2-meter air temperature over the calendar day.
